target_strategy.positioning: Backend-focused TypeScript Software Engineer with commercial Node.js, React, API integration and production reliability experience, complemented by current NestJS and Python/FastAPI portfolio work for Cello's ramp-up-friendly product engineering environment.
target_strategy.main_angle: Primary angle: a production-proven Node.js/TypeScript engineer who can contribute across backend services, APIs and React while transferring quickly into Cello's NestJS/Python stack. The three strongest supporting arguments are: (1) commercial Node.js/TypeScript and React delivery on a large multi-locale e-commerce platform, backed by the EPAM platform overview and CommerceTools case; (2) practical experience with external integrations, event-driven and long-running workflows, retries, idempotency and production debugging, backed by the ProductsUp synchronization, Amplience automation and customer notification cases; and (3) current hands-on AI-assisted engineering and portfolio development, including NestJS/TypeScript JobFlow and Python/FastAPI/OpenAI work, backed by the JobFlow CV Pipeline and AI Job Assistant cases.
risk_mitigation: Present NestJS, Python, FastAPI and OpenAI API only as current personal or portfolio evidence, not commercial production experience.
Do not claim AWS experience; position Azure serverless experience as transferable cloud knowledge and show willingness to learn AWS.
Keep React and Next.js framed as production contribution within a backend-focused fullstack role rather than frontend specialization.
Avoid unsupported claims about direct customer-developer collaboration, referral or growth-domain expertise, startup ownership and founder-facing product decisions.
Keep the mandatory current-work block compact so EPAM remains the dominant commercial evidence.
Use cautious English positioning: professional use in meetings and documentation is confirmed, but spoken fluency should be validated in interview.

cv_content.headline: Backend-focused TypeScript Software Engineer | Node.js | APIs | React | E-commerce Integrations
summary: Backend-focused TypeScript Software Engineer with commercial Node.js experience across production backend services, API integrations and React/Next.js feature delivery.
Built reliable e-commerce and integration workflows involving external APIs, long-running processing, retries, idempotency, data validation and production debugging.
Strong PostgreSQL foundation from production financial systems, with current portfolio work adding hands-on NestJS/TypeScript and Python/FastAPI/OpenAI experience.
Based in Cologne, Germany and authorized to work in Germany; open to English-speaking remote or hybrid teams in Europe.
Professional English use includes Jira, documentation, daily meetings, retrospectives and short Product Owner calls.
